title: Python: Rule 6 decompression
description: Implement Rule 6 EDHOC decompression in Python. Acceptance: decompresses to original headers, round-trip passes.
notes: Reconciled stale EDHOC wording to the controlling Rule 6 global 0200::/8 OSCORE profile. Existing Python decompressor already implements the strict inverse through OscoreUdpGlobalProfile and profile revalidation, so added isolated acceptance coverage in python/tests/schc/test_rule6_decompression.py without modifying concurrently dirty source. Evidence: canonical shared oscore_global bytes; independently packed 286-bit residue and exact recompression; every truncated residue length; both padding bits; token truncation/reserved TKL; absent/reserved/truncated/invalid/duplicate OSCORE options and empty payload marker; exact MAX_PACKET_SIZE roundtrip and one-over rejection; immutable input and failure non-mutation. Validation passed: 15 focused; combined Rule5/6/header/vector selector 320 passed; broader tests/schc excluding concurrently changing test_fragment.py 1144 passed; Ruff, mypy, and git diff check passed.
close_reason: Superseding Rule 6 global-OSCORE inverse is strictly validated against canonical vectors, malformed residues, and profile boundaries
